limits: Read-only decision simulation: no real Git, cleanup, release, skill installation, reconciliation, PDF conversion, or delegation was performed. Only this results file was written.
One worker handled all 27 behavior and 45 selection cases; cases are not independent fresh model trials. Model and reasoning settings were inherited, not independently verified.

Used only tasks.json and baseline skill entrypoints, relevant baseline resources, and baseline description/adapter policy. Did not inspect candidate, criteria, other results, or current repository skill versions.
Selection decisions were made from descriptions and adapter policies; the same worker had previously read behavior entrypoints for overlapping skills.
Initial broad reads had truncated tool output; task-relevant omitted entrypoints and resources were reread in smaller batches before decisions.

merge-ancestor: baseline integrate mode lacks an explicit already-integrated no-op branch. I would use observed ancestry and present behavior to finish without creating a merge; a literal new-merge/MERGE_HEAD reading could instead stall.

skills-managed: baseline skills-cli entrypoint and install recipe both block locally modified desired paths, whereas the separately evaluated baseline sjskills skill explicitly permits trusted same-source local-modification preservation and replacement. review-delegated: baseline Bucket II language broadly restricts design changes, but the user's explicit settled implementation request supplies the required approval; no new approval was simulated.
Unavailable real repository, OS, PR, and PDF evidence was not invented. Actions and conditional gates describe intended execution, not verified outcomes.

input.ARCHITECTURE.md:
# Architecture

The worker consumes a job and delegates execution to `src/jobs/runner.ts`.

## Flow

`src/worker.ts` passes a pending job to `src/jobs/runner.ts`, which checks its state, marks it running, invokes the handler, then marks it done. Failure marks it failed and preserves the original error.

## Start here

- `src/worker.ts`: worker boundary.
- `src/jobs/runner.ts`: transition owner and handler execution.

## Invariants

Only pending jobs start. The runner owns state transitions. Each invocation calls the handler at most once. Failure must not be reported as success.

## Future design

Payments is accepted but unimplemented; [its design](docs/payments.md) owns that target.
